close-label.description: Accessible name for the built-in Close button. Translate this for localized interfaces.

heading.description: Title and accessible name. Provide a heading whenever the drawer opens.

modal.description: Makes the page behind the sheet inert. Set modal="false" for continued page interaction.

open.description: Reflected live state. Setting it to false requests dismissal and may be vetoed.

placement.description: Logical edge. Use bottom for an action sheet with a swipe handle. Unknown values use end.

size.description: Optional CSS length. Overrides the 18rem themed width or bottom height cap.

--ki-corner-control.description: Deprecated alias kept for pre-Fase-1 consumers; use ki.radius.md.

--ki-density-space-scale.description: Multiplies every scaled container padding and gap (card, dialog, alert, list, list item, select listbox, tab panel, tooltip).

--ki-density-target-min.description: The smallest pointer target any density may produce: 24 x 24 CSS px by default and in compact (WCAG 2.5.8 AA), 44 x 44 in touch (WCAG 2.5.5). It floors a shrinking control but never lifts what a control paints: a control painted smaller extends its target to it, invisibly; rows and tabs grow to it (spec 045 A1).

--ki-dialog-backdrop-bg.description: color used by the dialog component for backdrop background.

--ki-dialog-divider-width.description: dimension used by the dialog component for the dividers under the heading and above the footer (Modal-header and Modal-actions 1px strokes). Zero removes them.

--ki-drawer-backdrop-filter.description: Complete backdrop filter applied behind the drawer surface.

--ki-drawer-bg.description: Raised surface color of the drawer.

--ki-drawer-bg-image.description: Optional image layered over the drawer surface.

--ki-drawer-close-size.description: Preferred size of the Close button before the density minimum.

--ki-drawer-fg.description: Foreground color on the drawer surface.

--ki-drawer-handle-size.description: Inline extent of the bottom-sheet handle.

--ki-drawer-radius.description: Radius of the corners on the inner edge of the drawer.

--ki-drawer-size.description: Default inline size of a side sheet and block-size cap of a bottom sheet.

--ki-focus-ring-color.description: Colour of the keyboard focus ring every focusable component draws: 3:1 or more against the page in every theme and scheme.

--ki-focus-ring-width.description: Thickness of the keyboard focus ring every focusable component draws (its outline). One token instead of one per component, so a mode or a theme changes every ring at once.

--ki-layout-spacing-2xl.description: The 2xl spacing step for a stack or grid gap.

--ki-layout-spacing-md.description: The md spacing step for a stack or grid gap.

--ki-layout-spacing-xl.description: The xl spacing step for a stack or grid gap.

--ki-motion-duration-medium-1.description: M3 md.sys.motion.duration.medium1 (250ms). onmars: MarsUI moderate step (240ms, 2x the 120ms base).

--ki-outline-low-em.description: semantic color for outline low em.

--ki-surface-hover-overlay-inverse.description: semantic color for surface hover overlay inverse.

--ki-surface-transparent.description: Transparent surface backing for a background image that carries its own opacity.

--ki-typography-family-body.description: semantic font family for typography family body.

--ki-typography-line-height-title-2.description: semantic dimension for typography line height title 2.

--ki-typography-size-title-2.description: semantic dimension for typography size title 2.

--ki-typography-weight-body-semibold.description: semantic font weight for typography weight body semibold.

component.description: An edge-aligned sheet for a focused task that keeps the current page in context.

ki-close.description:
Requests dismissal before the drawer closes, also on `close()` or a cleared `open`: it
can fire without a gesture. Call preventDefault() to keep it open, for example when
edits are unsaved. The event carries the reason in detail.reason.

close.description: Requests dismissal. An application can veto it by canceling ki-close.

show.description: Opens the sheet. A focused invoker receives focus again after modal dismissal.

footer.description: The action row, collapsed when empty.

heading.description: The visible title that names the sheet.

closeLabel.description: Accessible name for the built-in Close button. Translate this for localized interfaces.

heading.description: Title and accessible name. Provide a heading whenever the drawer opens.

modal.description: Makes the page behind the sheet inert. Set modal="false" for continued page interaction.

open.description: Reflected live state. Setting it to false requests dismissal and may be vetoed.

placement.description: Logical edge. Use bottom for an action sheet with a swipe handle. Unknown values use end.

size.description: Optional CSS length. Overrides the 18rem themed width or bottom height cap.

slots.description: The drawer's content, such as fields or a short list of actions.

footer.description: Optional actions such as Save. Wire these in the application.

header-actions.description: Optional actions between the heading and Close button.
